name: hmi_rename_screen_group
description: Rename an exact screen group in place while preserving its child objects; existing siblings are never overwritten.

new_name.description: New group name; '/' is not allowed.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

on_conflict.description: Required conflict behavior; only 'fail' is supported.
